teams.detail: Jedd Fisch is calling plays himself after OC Jimmie Dougherty departed in February, while commits kept shining at summer camps per UW's July 19 recruiting roundup. Season opens with the Boeing Apple Cup vs. Washington State, Sunday, Sept. 6 (1 p.m. PT, NBC) at Husky Stadium.

Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding through the transfer portal after a 16-17 finish and Zoom Diallo's departure, with Rainier Beach's Jaylen Petty among the portal targets and the Huskies in the mix for a top-ranked 2026 recruit's decision. Center Hannes Steinbach went 14th overall to Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft.

NFL owners are expected to vote in August on the Khosla family's record $9.612 billion purchase of the defending Super Bowl champions. Rookies reported to the Virginia Mason Athletic Center July 17; OLB Derick Hall signed a three-year extension and Seattle added veteran tackle Bobby Hart for camp depth.

Detroit closed a rough 2026 Summer League with a 101-87 finale loss to Miami, but the bigger story is Jalen Duren's extension talks gaining 'momentum' after the Caris LeVert-to-Milwaukee trade freed cap space for a reported five-year deal worth up to $287 million.

Seattle beat the Giants 6-3 Sunday to reach .500 on the season and opens a three-game set at home against Cincinnati tonight, 9:40 p.m. PT at T-Mobile Park (George Kirby vs. Andrew Abbott). Texas leads the AL West at just 50-49, so the Mariners sit right in the middle of a jammed division and wild-card race.

headlines.headline: Ohio judge refuses to pause 5-in-5 ruling as more than 45 seniors - including Donovan Dent - sue for a final year of eligibility
headlines.detail: A federal judge in Ohio denied the NCAA's motion to stay its preliminary injunction pending appeal, keeping the original 15 plaintiffs eligible to play a fifth season in 2026-27 while the NCAA's appeal proceeds; a separate suit filed Friday in California adds more than 45 graduated seniors seeking the same eligibility. St. John's also confirmed forward Donnie Freeman will miss next season with an Achilles injury.

headlines.headline: Warriors win NBA Summer League title as Yaxel Lendeborg's 21 and 10 edges Cameron Boozer's Grizzlies 94-90
headlines.detail: No. 11 pick Yaxel Lendeborg scored 21 points and grabbed 10 rebounds to earn Summer League MVP as Golden State beat Memphis and No. 3 pick Cameron Boozer 94-90 Sunday night in Las Vegas, capping an offseason otherwise dominated by the blockbuster trade sending Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis to Miami for Tyler Herro and a package of picks.

headlines.headline: Khosla family's record $9.612 billion Seahawks purchase awaits an August owners' vote as camps open league-wide
headlines.detail: NFL owners are expected to meet in August to ratify the Khosla family's record $9.612 billion agreement to buy the defending Super Bowl champion Seahawks, as rookies for the 49ers and other clubs report to training camp this week and the Cardinals and Panthers prepare to open camp ahead of the Aug. 6 Hall of Fame Game.

headlines.headline: SEC Media Days open in Tampa with Sankey's state-of-the-conference address as Lane Kiffin's LSU debut still looms
headlines.detail: SEC commissioner Greg Sankey opened four days of Media Days in Tampa on Monday, with Kentucky's Will Stein, Missouri's Eliah Drinkwitz, Oklahoma's Brent Venables and Tennessee's Josh Heupel taking the podium as the conference enters its first-ever nine-game schedule and a third straight season without a national title; Lane Kiffin's first appearance as LSU's coach and Arch Manning's Texas spotlight headline later in the week.
